results.title: African health ministers meet to tackle challenges
results.description: By Damilola Samuel Health ministers from 47 African countries have begun discussions in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, on measures to strengthen healthcare systems and improve the continent’s response to emerging health challenges. The three-day meeting, which opened on Tuesday, is the 76th session of the World Health Organisation Regional Committee for Africa and brings together health [...] The post African health ministers meet to tackle challenges appeared first on Vanguard News .
